title: Govt introduces MMDR Amendment Bill, 2026
summary: Amends Mines and Minerals (Development & Regulation) Act, 1957...

items: Amends Mines and Minerals (Development & Regulation) Act, 1957
**NMET** to be expanded/renamed National Mineral Exploration **and Development** Trust — will now fund mine/mineral development too
Captive mines' 50% annual sale cap proposed to be removed; deep-seated minerals (>200m) — one-time lease extension proposed (Composite licence up to 30%; Mining lease up to 10%)

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → Captive mine 50% cap removal; NMET renaming.
